problem_text:
A logistics manager is preparing a shipment for a fleet of cargo drones that will traverse a remote region over three consecutive days. They must select a combination of cargo packages to maximize total revenue while adhering to the maximum payload capacity of the drone carrier.

The available cargo packages are:
* Package A: weight 17kg, revenue 99 units
* Package B: weight 48kg, revenue 11 units
* Package C: weight 42kg, revenue 260 units
* Package D: weight 17kg, revenue 30 units
* Package E: weight 5kg, revenue 26 units
* Package F: weight 23kg, revenue 296 units
* Package G: weight 31kg, revenue 233 units
* Package H: weight 37kg, revenue 259 units
* Package I: weight 50kg, revenue 73 units
* Package J: weight 13kg, revenue 35 units
* Package K: weight 24kg, revenue 209 units
* Package L: weight 17kg, revenue 186 units
* Package M: weight 34kg, revenue 183 units
* Package N: weight 9kg, revenue 178 units
* Package O: weight 10kg, revenue 72 units
* Package P: weight 47kg, revenue 192 units
* Package Q: weight 6kg, revenue 148 units
* Package R: weight 23kg, revenue 214 units
* Package S: weight 7kg, revenue 170 units
* Package T: weight 38kg, revenue 82 units
* Package U: weight 25kg, revenue 268 units
* Package V: weight 19kg, revenue 139 units
* Package W: weight 23kg, revenue 93 units
* Package X: weight 37kg, revenue 38 units
* Package Y: weight 8kg, revenue 109 units
* Package Z: weight 31kg, revenue 57 units
* Package AA: weight 21kg, revenue 123 units
* Package AB: weight 17kg, revenue 236 units
* Package AC: weight 11kg, revenue 229 units
* Package AD: weight 41kg, revenue 114 units

Furthermore, due to a routing constraint, exactly one of Package A or Package B must be included in the shipment.

If Package C is included, the operational payload capacity of the drone carrier is diminished by 10 kg.
The drone carrier can support a maximum total payload of 511 kg. The manager must determine which packages to load.
